mapper.select: select b.brand_name ,p.product_name ,p.original_price ,p.price ,p.category_id ,p.discount_rate from product p join brand b on p.brand_id = b.brand_id where p.product_id = #{product_id}
select image_url,sort_order from product_image where product_id = #{product_id} order by sort_order

SELECT og.option_group_id, og.group_name, og.required, ov.option_value_id, ov.option_name FROM option_group og JOIN option_value ov ON og.option_group_id = ov.option_group_id WHERE og.product_id = #{product_id} ORDER BY og.sort_order, ov.sort_order

SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORY START WITH CATEGORY_ID = ( SELECT CATEGORY_ID FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{product_id} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR PARENT_ID = CATEGORY_ID ORDER BY LEVEL DESC
